title: solaredge: Do some error checking and fix Coverity issues
description:
Check for the total length being less than the key length to avoid
overflow.
Avoid an unnecessary memcpy.
Check for gcry_cipher_encrypt failing.
Do not create a new TVB with a too long length that points to
uninitialized data; the length of the decrypted buffer does not
include the length of the key.

Coverity CIDs 1481950, 1477498, 1499456, 1477476, 1499451
